scenario: 今天检索赛道有 10 篇，5 篇有深度解读。帕绍大学的实验给了一个直接的结论：要做重排序，就按重排序来微调，新出的决策模型并不更好。LightRetriever 把查询编码从跑一遍大模型变成查表，适合查询量大的线上检索。另外几篇讲多模态向量的模态鸿沟和推理增强，以及扫描版 PDF 的检索流程。做搜索和检索增强生成的团队可以先看前两篇。

papers.title: System One models Are Not Better Rerankers
papers.authors: Michael Dinzinger, Kanishka Ghosh Dastidar, Michael Granitzer
papers.abstract: System One models, or decision models, answer a question about an input with a calibrated probability instead of generated text. Within weeks of the first release, in September 2026, they were used as rerankers. We test whether the decision fine-tuning behind them makes a better reranker than plain reranker fine-tuning of the same model. For six Qwen backbones from 0.6B to 27B parameters and ten TREC DL and BEIR collections, we compare the untuned model, asked zero-shot, with its decision fine-tunes and its reranker fine-tunes, two of which we train ourselves. In our work, we draw the conclusion that decision fine-tuning never makes the better reranker. From 0.6B to 9B, reranker fine-tuning wins on every backbone by 5 to 29 points nDCG@10, also on zero-shot collections, and at 27B the two tie. Up to 9B, decision fine-tuning adds nothing over simply asking the untuned model. Moreover, we find that the calibration advantage of decision models depends on the question. Asked whether a pass
papers.summary: 拿新出的决策模型给检索结果重新排序，并不比专门微调的重排序模型好，这是帕绍大学这篇论文的结论。决策模型也叫 System One 模型，对一个问题直接给出校准过的“是”的概率，不生成文字，刚发布几周就被拿去做重排序。论文用同一个底座比较两种微调：决策微调用各类是非题训练模型给出准确的概率，重排序微调则只用 MS MARCO 的查询和段落训练模型判断段落是否相关。在六个不同大小的 Qwen 底座和十个 TREC DL、BEIR 数据集上，==中小规模时重排序微调在每个底座上都赢==，9B 及以下 nDCG@10 高出 5 到 29 分，到 27B 两者打平。这个规模以下，决策微调并不比直接问未微调的原模型更好。作者的结论很直白：需要重排序模型，就按重排序来微调。

papers.title: LightRetriever: A LLM-based Text Retrieval Architecture with Extremely Faster Query Inference
papers.authors: Guangyuan Ma, Yongliang Ma, Xuanrui Gou, Zhenpeng Su, Ming Zhou, Songlin Hu
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs)-based text retrieval retrieves documents relevant to search queries based on vector similarities. Documents are pre-encoded offline, while queries arrive in real-time, necessitating an efficient online query encoder. Although LLMs significantly enhance retrieval capabilities, serving deeply parameterized LLMs slows down query inference throughput and increases demands for online deployment resources. In this paper, we propose LightRetriever, a novel LLM-based retriever with extremely lightweight query encoders. Our method retains a full-sized LLM for document encoding, but reduces the workload of query encoding to no more than an embedding lookup. Compared to serving a full LLM on an A800 GPU, our method achieves over a thousand times of speedup in query encoding and over 10× increase in end-to-end retrieval throughput. Extensive experiments on large-scale retrieval benchmarks show that LightRetriever generalizes well across diverse tasks, maintaining an av
papers.summary: 用大模型做文本检索，文档可以提前离线编码，查询却要实时编码，每来一个查询都要跑一遍大模型，吞吐低、部署贵。LightRetriever 让两边不再对称：文档仍用完整的大模型编码，查询端只剩查表。训练时把一段共享提示词接上单个词送进大模型，得到这个词的向量，查询向量取各个词向量的平均。==词表里每个词的向量都能提前算好存成一张表==，上线后查询只需查表再求平均。和在 A800 GPU 上跑完整大模型相比，查询编码快 1000 倍以上，端到端检索吞吐提高 10 倍以上，在多个检索基准上，平均保留完整大模型检索器约 95% 的检索指标。

deep_reading.title: LightRetriever: A LLM-based Text Retrieval Architecture with Extremely Faster Query Inference

papers.title: Closing the Modality Gap via Simplex-Constrained Representations
papers.authors: Shubham Gupta, Siva Reddy, Perouz Taslakian, Valentina Zantedeschi, Cem Subakan
papers.abstract: While multimodal contrastive models like CLIP and CLAP successfully learn shared representations, their embeddings typically exhibit a persistent \emph{modality gap}. We propose addressing this separation through a purely geometric approach: changing the embedding domain from the unit sphere, $S^{d-1}$, to the probability simplex, $Δ^{d-1}$. Although both manifolds share the same intrinsic dimension, the simplex acts as a structural prior; its nonnegative, unit-mass constraints serve as a cross-modal calibration that forces both modalities to ground themselves in the same coordinate system. By attaching lightweight softmax adapters and using Total Variation similarity, we reduce the centroid $\ell_2$ gap by 97--99\% across five multimodal retrieval benchmarks. This confirms that simplicial geometry induces genuine semantic alignment, matching or exceeding the retrieval performance of standard unconstrained models.
papers.summary: CLIP 这类图文或音文对比学习模型，两种模态的向量虽然对齐训练过，却常常整体错开、各占一片区域，这叫模态鸿沟。这篇论文不改主干模型，只改向量所在的空间：把通常的单位球面换成概率单纯形，也就是每一维都不能为负、所有维加起来等于 1。实现上只在输出端接一个很轻的 softmax 适配器，相似度改用两个分布的总变差距离来算。==两种模态被迫落在同一套坐标里，彼此的偏移基本消失==。在五个跨模态检索基准上，两种模态中心点之间的距离缩小 97% 到 99%，检索效果持平或更好。

deep_reading.title: Closing the Modality Gap via Simplex-Constrained Representations

papers.title: Beyond Post-Hoc Rewards: Privileged Reasoning Exploration for Multimodal Embeddings
papers.authors: Tianyu Yang, Yijun Tian, Lars Benedikt Kaesberg, Jan Philip Wahle, Bela Gipp, Terry Ruas, Daniel Kurzawe
papers.abstract: Advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have driven substantial progress in multimodal embeddings. Recent methods exploit generative capabilities by augmenting embedded inputs with self-generated reasoning to produce more informative embeddings. However, conventional retrieval supervision for training embedding models specifies pairwise relevance relations without explicitly guiding the reasoning used for input augmentation. Such reasoning is neither directly observed nor uniquely determined by the input, allowing multiple plausible traces to introduce semantic cues of varying retrieval utility. Existing approaches largely optimize reasoning conditioned on the input alone, limiting the exploration of retrieval-relevant traces. We introduce PILOT, a framework that models reasoning as a latent variable and instantiates its prior and posterior distributions as distinct reasoning modes of a shared MLLM. The prior conditions only on the input, whereas the posterior uses additio
papers.summary: 一些多模态向量模型会先让模型针对输入写一段推理，再把推理一起编码，得到信息更多的向量。但训练数据只告诉模型哪两样东西相关，从不告诉它该写什么推理，只看输入去摸索，很难找到对检索真正有用的推理。PILOT 让同一个多模态大模型扮演两个角色：一个只看输入写推理，另一个在训练时还能看到配对的正确答案，因而更容易写出有用的推理。==后者写出的推理会挑一部分教给前者==：一看用这段推理生成的向量检索效果好不好，二看前者只凭输入写出这段推理的概率高不高，两者都高的权重才大。上线时只用前者。在含 78 项任务的 MMEB-V2 上，2B 和 7B 模型总分分别提高 3.2 和 3.3 分，视觉文档检索提升最大。

deep_reading.title: Beyond Post-Hoc Rewards: Privileged Reasoning Exploration for Multimodal Embeddings

papers.title: 56 scanned pages to a cited answer in 5 minutes: RAG pipeline for the documents search cannot read
papers.abstract: Ask a scanned, table-heavy PDF a question in plain language and get an answer stamped with the page it came from, because jina-ocr-v1 turns every page into structured Markdown that Elasticsearch embeds at ingest.
papers.summary: 企业很多知识躺在扫描版 PDF 里，传统搜索读不出来。Elastic 这篇教程搭了一条检索增强生成流程：上传一份 56 页的扫描版植物指南，用自然语言提问，几分钟内得到带页码出处的回答。关键是 jina-ocr-v1，它一次读一整页图片，直接输出保留阅读顺序的 Markdown，表格保留成表格，手写字也能转出来，页眉页脚会被去掉。==解析结果写进索引时自动切块、算向量，再用关键词和语义混合检索==，最后交给大模型生成带引用的回答。整条流程跑在一个平台里，不用自己部署模型和 GPU。

papers.title: Yalda-Embedding: Open Development of a Competitive Persian Retrieval Model
papers.authors: Yalda Taheri, Mohammad Hassan Heydari, Armon Rasooli
papers.abstract: Despite advances in multilingual text representations, effective dense retrieval for Persian remains constrained by the limited availability of language-specific training resources and compact embedding models. We present Yalda Embedding, a 595.8-million-parameter Persian retrieval model adapted from Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B using more than one million query-document pairs. On eight Persian retrieval tasks from FaMTEB, the model achieves the highest macro-average among the evaluated 0.6B models, scoring 0.5488 and outperforming Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B and F2LLM-v2-0.6B on every task. It also approaches Qwen3-Embedding-4B, winning on four tasks, tying on one, and trailing by 0.0075 in macro-average. An incremental ablation study examines contrastive batch size, optimization stabilization, and relational knowledge distillation from F2LLM-v2-8B. Under the one-epoch training setup, contrastive fine-tuning alone yields a modest mean improvement over initialization and regressions on two tasks. The
papers.summary: 波斯语缺少专门的训练数据和小巧的向量模型，稠密检索一直做不好。这篇论文从 Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B 出发，用一百多万对波斯语查询和文档继续训练，得到约 6 亿参数的 Yalda Embedding，训练和数据都公开。在 FaMTEB 的八个波斯语检索任务上，它在同规模模型里平均分最高，每个任务都超过原模型和另一个同规模的 F2LLM-v2，也已接近大好几倍的 Qwen3-Embedding-4B。==消融显示，光做对比学习微调提升有限，还会让个别任务变差==，把每批负样本从 63 个加到 511 个、加上梯度裁剪和学习率预热，再让它学习大得多的 F2LLM-v2-8B 对同一批文档的相对排序，分数才推上去。

papers.title: Scalable PDF Retrieval with Cohere Embed 5 and Qdrant Asymmetric Quantization
papers.abstract: Cohere released Embed 5, a family of embedding models. The family has a quality-focused model, Embed 5 Pro (embed-v5.0-pro), and a lighter one, Embed 5 Fast (embed-v5.0-fast). Both accept text and images, support 100+ languages, and share an embedding space.
papers.summary: PDF 里很多答案藏在图表里，OCR 转文字会丢掉版面信息，常用的做法是给每页存约一千个小块向量，存储很重。Qdrant 实测发现，Cohere 新发布的 Embed 5 Pro 一页只用一个向量，在五个公开英文文档集上的效果已经超过几种多向量模型。再进一步压缩：只保留前 512 维，每维只存正负号，查询向量则保留较高精度，粗排后再用完整向量给靠前的结果重排。==页面向量压到最小时，排序质量几乎没掉==，每页内存只占 64 字节，重排后的 nDCG@10 仍有完整浮点向量的 99.2%。

papers.title: Mitigating Saliency Collapse: Robust Saliency-Aware Long-Text Image-Text Alignment
papers.authors: Qiuyu Kong, Zanxi Ruan, Marco Cristani, Yiming Wang
papers.abstract: Long-text image-text alignment is essential for fine-grained scene understanding, yet existing methods mainly focus on extending context length or improving local alignment. We identify an overlooked failure mode, saliency collapse, where models over-rely on text that features visual prominence while underutilizing non-salient context. Consequently, retrieval performance degrades sharply when salient content is reduced, despite that the non-salient context remains informative. To address this, we propose RoSA, a saliency-aware finetuning framework that decomposes image-text pairs into complementary salient and contextual views, enabling joint learning of prominent and contextual semantics. We propose a modality-independent decomposition strategy to combine object-level visual saliency estimation with LLM-based text decomposition to bridge vision and language. We employ auxiliary objectives to explicitly align these views, ensuring robust representation with both salient and contextual
papers.summary: 用长段文字检索图片时，模型往往只盯着描述显眼物体的那几句，周围交代环境和细节的文字几乎不用。这篇论文把这个现象叫作显著性坍缩：把查询里写显眼物体的句子删掉一部分，检索准确率掉得比随机删同样多的字快得多。他们提出 RoSA，用物体级的视觉显著性估计切分图片，用大模型切分文字，把每对图文拆成显眼部分和背景部分两份。==训练时额外要求两份各自对齐==，让模型两种信息都学。长文本检索明显提升，显眼内容被删时也更稳，这些附加目标还能直接加到现有方法上。

papers.title: UAE GovTrust Scope Filtering Gains and Routing Failures in Bilingual Public Service Retrieval
papers.abstract: Public-service queries can mention several locations while only one controls the requested service. We study this distinction in UAE GovTrust, a controlled English-Arabic retrieval diagnostic comprising 22 authored service summaries and 50 scenarios with 110 query variants. Twelve methods separate lexical and dense ranking, rank fusion, scope filtering, a multilingual cross-encoder, and direct service lookup. On 72 matched answerable queries with bilingual evidence, role-filtered reciprocal rank fusion retrieves a relevant first result for 69 queries (95.8%), versus 47 (65.3%) for unfiltered fusion; filtered dense retrieval and direct lookup each achieve 68 (94.4%). With English-only evidence, excluding zero-score lexical candidates raises filtered fusion from 52 to 64 correct first hits. However, the unchanged router selects the correct action and scope for only 2 of 168 post-audit perturbations covering paraphrases, irrelevant facts, negation, and corrections. These perturbations are
papers.summary: 办政务事项的问题里常常出现好几个地点，但真正决定该办哪项服务的只有一个，比如住在甲地却要给乙地的公司办执照。这篇论文为此做了一个阿联酋中英双语的检索诊断集，比较了十二种方法。==先判断哪个地点决定要办的服务，只保留这个地点的服务条目，再融合关键词和向量两路排序，效果最好==：在可回答的双语问题里，首条结果命中率约 96%，不过滤只有 65%。但负责判断要办什么、在哪办的路由模块很脆弱，问题换个说法、加句无关信息或带个否定，168 个变体里它只判对 2 个。

papers.title: Cycle-of-Thought: Self-Evaluative Iterative Reasoning for Table Visual Question Answering in Document Images
papers.abstract: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have significantly improved Visual Question Answering (VQA) performance, yet their reasoning over structured content such as tables remains inconsistent, often plagued by spatial misalignment and logical hallucinations. Existing approaches for improving table VQA typically rely on architectural modifications or expensive supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which impose high barriers to entry due to the need for large-scale, expert-annotated datasets and significant computational resources. In this work, we propose Self-RefineVQA, a training-free, inference-time self-correction framework that improves table VQA performance without additional labeled data or model updates. Inspired by human revision behavior, our method enables a single VLM to iteratively act as a generator, critic, and refiner, forming a closed self-feedback loop that corrects common reasoning errors through prompt-guided re-evaluation. Experiments on tabular VQA benchmarks dem
papers.summary: 视觉语言模型看文档图片里的表格答题时，常对错行列、算错数，而微调要大量专家标注，门槛很高。这篇论文提出 Self-RefineVQA，不训练、不加标注，让同一个模型轮流当三个角色：先作答，再像审稿人一样检查答案和表格是否对得上，最后按检查意见改答案，如此循环几轮。==小模型受益最大==，Qwen2.5-VL 3B 在 WikiTableQuestions 上最多提升 13%，能和大得多的模型相比。代价是推理成本随轮数线性增加，但省掉了人工标注。
